summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the formatter entry emitting "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) for the title control. CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run (per instructions); verification was by reading only. Mypy, Black, and pytest have not been executed. No commits were made.
